Chapter 984: Chapter 3 Fierce Sun (Please Subscribe)_2

The second choice was to use the World-Breaking Origin Force to resist that dark force.

Lin Yuan didn’t need to completely solve this dark force, he just needed to hold on until he returned to the Yu Family, where ther strong members of the family would come to the rescue.

“Temporarily resisting this dark force requires a hundred strands of World-Breaking Origin Force…”

In the blink of an eye, Lin Yuan’s thoughts raced as he started making choices.

“Forget it, the identity I’ve descended with this time is not bad, at least I won’t have to worry about cultivation resources in the early stage.” After pondering for just a breath’s time, Lin Yuan had made up his mind.

As the most outstanding disciple of the Yu Family, and with his parents holding high authority within the Yu Family, such a starting point was indeed rare.

It would allow Lin Yuan to avoid many detours in the early stage.

Although a second-rate family in the Qingfen Domain was not considered core upper echelon, it was still prominent enough to warrant Lin Yuan’s participation.

“It’s just a hundred strands of World-Breaking Origin Force after all.”

With a slight stir of Lin Yuan’s mind, an invisible force began to emerge within his body. This force quickly suppressed and slowed down the dark corrupting force, reducing the rate of its spread and prolonging Lin Yuan’s survival time.

The most crucial thing was that this force wouldn’t leave any traces inside his body, reducing any chances of it being detected by others.

Whoosh whoosh whoosh.

Space and time were distorting.

An old servant with white hair quickly brought Lin Yuan to the front of a grand mansion.

“What’s going on?”

A tall man appeared, looking towards the white-haired old servant and noticing Lin Yuan, whose energy was hanging by a thread.

“Yan.” The tall man’s expression changed, and with a lift of his hand, the scenery transformed, instantly bringing the white-haired old servant and Lin Yuan to the deepest part of the mansion.

Here, old men were sitting cross-legged, their auras deep and mysterious. At this moment, they all opened their eyes at once and looked towards the tall man.

“Elders, my son needs your help.”

Without mincing words, the tall man didn’t even bother to ask why Lin Yuan was injured at this moment.

“This is the Dongyang Clan’s doing.”

“How audacious of the Dongyang Clan to attack a disciple of our Yu Family.”

Several deeply-aura-ed elders grimaced and acted without hesitation, stopping the spreading dark corrupting force inside Lin Yuan’s body.

“Lucky, he returned just in time. Had it been a few more breaths later, it would have been real trouble.”

The leading elder spoke. He looked at the tall man and frowned, saying, “What in the world happened?”

“Clan Leader, elders…” The white-haired old servant, seeing that Lin Yuan was fine, let out a deep breath of relief and immediately shared how Dongyang Meng had plotted against the young master.

“To become a disciple under Lord Qingfen, the Dongyang Family has indeed become unscrupulous.” The tall man added in a timely manner, at the side.

“Becoming a disciple of Lord Qingfen, that’s a chance to soar to the heavens. Who would hold back?” The leading elder of the Yu Family spoke, dissatisfaction in his tone.

He wasn’t angry at the Dongyang Clan, but at Yu Yan.

Knowing that it was a time when competition between the two great families was most fierce, yet he still went out to meet with Dongyang Meng in private? Wasn’t that foolish?

“The elder speaks the truth,” the tall man immediately replied at the side.

He too knew there was something wrong with his son. The Dongyang Clan attacking his son?

If Yu Yan had fought back, using this private meeting with Dongyang Meng as a chance to bring over many strong members of the Yu Family, turning the tables on Dongyang Meng, how could he have ended up in such a state now?

Then, with Dongyang Meng dead, the likelihood of Yu Yan becoming a disciple of Lord Qingfen would have greatly increased, propelling the Yu Family to the skies, becoming a top-tier family within the Qingfen Yu.

“Elder, my son now…” The tall man asked cautiously.

“His life has been saved, but to fully recover would take decades without even thinking about it. And in a year’s time, it will be time to head to Qingfen City.” The Yu Family elder said, without the possibility of recovery, there’s no chance of contending with Dongyang Meng, which is the same as freely giving away the chance to become a disciple under Lord Qingfen.

“That’s good to hear.” The tall man breathed a sigh of relief, immediately thinking of something, and quickly added: “I will go back and properly teach Yan.”

After saying this, he hurriedly left with Lin Yuan and the old servant.

…

“Finally got through it.”

Lin Yuan steadied himself, the World-Breaking Origin Force Fruit truly was miraculous, invisible and intangible, undetectable to anyone but Lin Yuan himself.

“Those few elders of the Yu Family, all at the twelfth layer strength?”

Lin Yuan inwardly sighed, although it’s just the Second Layer of the Path Splitting Realm, it’s still the Second Layer.

The Yu Family is merely a second-class family in the Qingfen Domain, yet they have several ancestors in the Path Splitting Realm presiding over, what about the first-class families then? And what about Lord Qingfen who looks over the entire Qingfen Domain?

“This is the Origin World…” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

In terms of world hierarchy, the Origin World is no weaker than the Chaos Void.

“The urgent task now is to recover from the injuries on my physical body and soul.”

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts and started to assess his own condition.

The dark corrosive power within his body had been thoroughly eradicated, but the injury remained, and it was extremely difficult to recover from. External forces had basically no effect, and he could only rely on his own Origin Source to gradually repair it.

This was also the reason why the Yu Family ancestor confirmed that it would take Lin Yuan decades to recover.

“Decades?”

Lin Yuan slightly shook his head, it would take Yu Yan decades to recover, but he would not need that long.

…

Within the universe.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

“The situation in the Origin World has finally stabilized.” A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face, it was his first arrival in the Origin World, and he did not wish to return defeated.

“Now, all that’s needed is to wait for the natural development over there in the Origin World.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself that, based on the intelligence he had obtained so far, the colossal extent of that Origin World was terrifying, especially the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, which was unfathomably profound.

…

Outside the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent.

An avatar of Lin Yuan appeared.

“This time, the speed was much faster.” Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

When Lin Yuan first arrived at the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent, he was only at the Eleventh Layer, and it took him four to five months just to approach it.

But now?

It’s been just a few days since he left the Main Universe.

“If I could step into the Eightfold Realm of Space-Time, I estimate it would take only a few breaths to arrive.” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Normally speaking, the Eightfold Realm of Space-Time is a comprehension of space and time belonging to a Chaos Venerable, as for the Ninth Realm of Space-Time? That’s the domain of a Chaos Great Saint.

Xuanhuang reached the pinnacle of the Ninth Realm of Space-Time in his mastering of space, invincible throughout the Chaos Void.

“The Thousand Treasures Convention is about to start.”

Lin Yuan immediately headed towards the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent.

He did not forget that his purpose for coming here was to bring many weapons, treasures, and rare artifacts to sell, and then to purchase that golden box at the Thousand Treasures Convention.

The golden box bore the mark of the Profound Xuanhuang lineage, only Lin Yuan knew that it should contain the treasures of the Profound Xuanhuang lineage from the past.

The golden box itself is nearly indestructible, which is why it has been passed down to the present, and the treasure contained within such a box must certainly be extraordinary, its true value definitely far exceeding thirty thousand chaos stones.

“However…”

As Lin Yuan got closer to the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent, he immediately sensed something was amiss.

Compared to his first arrival outside the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent, the atmosphere of the Chaos Continent now was noticeably more tense, with a significant increase in the number of patrollers.

In the very center of the continent, that black mountain peak that pierced the sky like a barb had somehow disappeared.

“Has some sort of incident occurred?” Lin Yuan speculated in his mind, the Ancient Ming Chaos Venerable had a great reputation in the nearby regions, for the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent to change like this… if it’s really an incident, it must not be small.

“The Chaos Void is full of crises, even the Chaos Continents with a Chaos Venerable at helm are not absolutely safe, and the void outside the Chaos Continents is even more dangerous.”

Lin Yuan felt deeply.

However, the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent has existed for hundreds of Cosmic Eras, and has gone through many calamities, but all have been withstood under the protection of the Ancient Ming Chaos Venerable.

“Whatever the incident, it has nothing to do with me, as long as I can buy that golden box, it’s fine to leave immediately.”

Lin Yuan thought, arriving at the entrance to the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent, and entered smoothly.

Very soon.

The two avatars converged, heading to the trading area of Mingchuan City, planning to sell the multitude of weapons, treasures, and rarities to acquire enough chaos stones.
